I Am A Disco Dancer – Zindagi Mera Gaana is one of the most iconic Bollywood disco anthems from the blockbuster film Disco Dancer (1982). Featuring the legendary Mithun Chakraborty, this electrifying song became a global sensation and remains a timeless favorite among music lovers.
